LOOK: Progressive groups stage an indignation rally in Boy Scout Circle, Quezon City on Thursday, August 7, against the Senate’s archiving of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. 

The protesters condemn the senators, who they allege have chosen impunity over accountability after voting yes to archive the impeachment case even while a motion for reconsideration remains pending in the Supreme Court.

📸: Santi San Juan | MB
